rationale: With only 21 minutes to close, KD has already gapped up 15% and is sitting at 82.9% of its intraday range with momentum clearly fading — the last five 1-minute candles show a drift from 17.34 down to 17.30 on declining volume, suggesting exhaustion rather than continuation. The 9-EMA at 17.47 is above current price, indicating short-term bearish pressure, but the tight spread and high relative volume make a clean directional read difficult this late in the session with no news catalyst to anchor a thesis. The risk of a sharp end-of-day reversal on a stock that has already moved this dramatically, combined with forced liquidation at close, makes the risk/reward unattractive in either direction.
